apps.name: CORE
apps.tagline: The clean, lightweight launcher for all Coresys apps.
apps.description: CORE Tools is a clean, lightweight suite of creative tools made for video editors, content creators, and post-production workflows. The goal is simple: provide small, focused apps that help with editing, without turning the workflow into an absolute mess.

apps.name: SLDR
apps.description: SLDR is a simple, lightweight audio sample browser for quickly auditioning and dragging samples into your DAW or editor. It supports drag-and-drop from the app to any other app that accepts audio files.

features.title: Search
features.body: Find a resource by name or by content with Smart Analysis.

features.title: Listen
features.body: Play sounds and music before they reach your timeline.

features.title: Drag
features.body: Drag what you found straight into any software.

features.title: Repeat
features.body: Next shot, same flow. Your library stays indexed between sessions.

apps.name: SPIR
apps.description: SPIR is a simple, lightweight browser for video resources (images, videos, green screens, LUTs and DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro presets) for quickly previewing assets and dragging them into your editor. It supports drag-and-drop from the app to any other app that accepts media files.

apps.name: Planwise
apps.description: Planwise is a simple, lightweight planning tool for organizing your tasks and activities. It helps you stay on top of your schedule and make the most of your time.

apps.name: DRIFT
apps.tagline: Let your ideas drift. Keep control of the road.
apps.description: DRIFT is a workspace designed for video creators and editors. From the first idea to the final cut, plan your projects, organize your workflow, write your scripts, and prepare your edits in one place. Build your scripts with integrated media, keep track of every task, manage your production calendar, and bring structure to your creative process without juggling a dozen different tools. Inspired by the flexibility of Notion, but purpose-built for the way video creators actually work.

screenshots.caption: Graphic designer Mode with calendar view

apps.name: Crayon
apps.tagline: Infinite whiteboard for your infinite ideas.
apps.description: Crayon is an infinite whiteboard built for thinking without limits. Sketch ideas, map out projects, and bring everything together on a single canvas that grows with you. Add shapes, sticky notes, text, images, and files of any kind, then arrange them freely to brainstorm, plan, or build moodboards. A blank canvas for every idea, connected to the way you create.
